text:
support-jen: Customer (AcmeMobile) reporting p99 spikes ~3.5s -> 20s for /v1/generate on Dedicated pool in the last 30m. They also saw several 504s and a handful of 500s. Attaching a couple request ids: req_17a3, req_17b0. Started after traffic spike ~09:30 PST.

ops-bot: ALERT: dedicated-pool dedicated-west-2-42 slot_util=100% queue_length=73 scaleups_pending=9 cold_gpus_booting=6

sre-oncall: Can you paste a sample x-request-id + trace? Which pool were they routed to?

support-jen: req_17a3; pool=dedicated-west-2-42. Trace snippet from the attach logs:
```
2026-02-28T16:48:12Z attach_request id=req_17a3 status=queued
2026-02-28T16:48:15Z scaleup_request pool=dedicated-west-2-42 action=allocate_slot attempt=1
2026-02-28T16:48:18Z attach_fail reason=handshake_timeout pod=slot-ckl94
2026-02-28T16:48:32Z attach_request id=req_17a3 status=attached
```

maria: Seeing a large fanout of concurrent attach attempts from multiple customers hitting that pool. Kube attach queue is piling up. Cold GPU boot time for that image is ~40-50s in current metric window. Also a spike in "PendingTerminating" slots.

eli: Looks like tombstoning on the provisioner side — slots enter PendingTerminating and are not being recycled back to Ready quickly. That explains sustained slot_util=100% even as requests backoff.

sre-oncall: Immediate mitigation plan: (1) route AcmeMobile to hosted fallback for now, (2) bump pool reserve by +4 slots, (3) enable aggressive_prewarm for dedicated-west-2-42. I'll run the toggles now.

kevin: I'll push a hotfix to skip the non-essential model init step for images marked warmup_cache=true, should shave cold boot time. Planning patch in ~10m.

ajay: Can we temporarily lower autoscaler scale_up_cooldown from 120s -> 30s for this pool and set max_scale_step=+6? If approved I can change policy.

sre-oncall: Approve. Apply change and monitor. Also adding admission priority for customer-tagged requests to reduce attach fanout pressure.

support-jen: Told customer we routed them to hosted fallback and increased pool burst capacity. They reported immediate reduction in 504s. They asked for root cause & ETA for full fix.

maria: Preliminary root cause: concurrent-attach fanout + slot tombstoning + conservative autoscaler cooldown caused scale-up lag. Cold boot latency for that model image amplified the effect.

eli: Follow-ups: [1] fix tombstoning/GC in provisioner (PR to remove deadlock on release path), [2] add per-customer prewarm reservations and routing guardrails, [3] emit attach_latency histogram tagged by pool+customer and surface in Console.

sre-oncall: Created incident ticket incident-2250001234 and assigned to eng-runtime. Runbook steps logged: fallback route, bump reserve, aggressive_prewarm, adjust autoscaler policy, hotfix rollout.

maria: Starting PR for GC fix and will coordinate canary rollout.

kevin: Hotfix deployed to staging, test shows cold boot down from ~45s -> ~12s for same image. Preparing prod rollout in a controlled fashion.

sre-oncall: Closing immediate customer-impact incident after monitoring for 30m. Keeping follow-up tasks open in incident ticket for root cause fixes and telemetry. Thanks team :tada:
